label: CKPT_SAMPLER_INCONSISTENT
fix_claim: restore() now loads the sampler position saved in the checkpoint instead of the previous attempt's progress file, so the resumed run replays step 8 onward with the same samples as the reference run.
patch:
--- a/job/ckpt.py
+++ b/job/ckpt.py
@@ -61,4 +61,4 @@
     opt.load_state_dict(sd)
     if "sampler" in state:  # checkpoints from before the sampler was tracked have no position
-        sampler.load_state(_progress(rank, state["sampler"]))
+        sampler.load_state(state["sampler"])
     return int(state["step"])
